Orders, returns and privacy

How orders work

Send your order on WhatsApp or through the cart. We confirm stock, the total and the delivery fee before you pay. Your order is processed once payment is received.

Returns and refunds

If an item arrives faulty, damaged or different from what you ordered, message us on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery with photos. We will arrange a replacement or refund.

Privacy

We use your name, phone number and delivery details only to process and deliver your order. We do not sell your information.
